title: Research-only typed prescribed-groundwater-level branch/state contract

ABOVE_OR_AT_TOP.semantics: special direct groundwater-level reconstruction branch; no generic reduced Richards solve

INSIDE_PROFILE.predicate: at least one node below prescribed gwl and not ABOVE_OR_AT_TOP
INSIDE_PROFILE.active_nodes: count of nodes whose z is above the effective prescribed groundwater level, after source snap rule
INSIDE_PROFILE.snap_rule: if z(active_nodes)-gwl < 1e-4 cm and active_nodes>0, set effective gwl to that node and decrement active_nodes
INSIDE_PROFILE.saturated_continuation: nodes below active domain are set to saturated water content; accepted lower profile heads are reconstructed from the vertical-flux chain
INSIDE_PROFILE.qbot: diagnosed after convergence from whole-profile mass/flux reconstruction

BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE.predicate: all hydraulic nodes lie above prescribed gwl
BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE.solver_semantics: same lower-head residual/Jacobian branch as mode 5

transaction_rule: Every H_phreatic research trial reconstructs this branch state from the same immutable accepted origin; rejected trials may not leave branch, active-domain, head, water-content or continuation state behind.
nonclaims: does not yet implement or qualify the inside-profile Richards solve
does not expose SWBOTB=1 in production
does not assert continuity across node/profile branch boundaries
does not alias current mode-5 interface head to H_phreatic
